tickets.title: Warn when serializing fixed length tuples with too few items
tickets.description: Add a PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue warning in the Rust serializer when a fixed-length tuple has fewer items than the schema expects. Currently only too-many items triggers a warning; this change adds symmetry by also warning on too-few items.

implementation_summary: This change implements 'Warn when serializing fixed length tuples with too few items' for the pydantic project. Add a PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue warning in the Rust serializer when a fixed-length tuple has fewer items than the schema expects. Currently only too-many items triggers a warning; this change adds symmetry by also warning on too-few items. The implementation modifies 2 existing files (pydantic-core/src/serializers/type_serializers/tuple.rs, pydantic-core/tests/serializers/test_list_tuple.py) and creates 0 new files. Emit a PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue warning when a tuple has fewer items than the fixed-length schema expects Maintain the existing warning behavior for tuples with too many items Implement the check in the Rust tuple serializer code
